info.title: ClaimCraft BD API
info.description: Bangladesh-first consumer resolution copilot API. Grounded dispute preparation and follow-up.

get.description: Liveness probe: verifies process is alive and responsive.
Readiness probe: reports readiness of database, storage, and models.
Returns enabled domain packs, supported languages, provider readiness, and release mode.
Returns sanitized build inventory and capability status without disclosing secrets.

post.description: Initializes or resumes an isolated anonymous guest session with HttpOnly cookie & JWT.
Upgrades an anonymous guest account to a permanent verified account, retaining cases.
Terminates the current session and clears session cookie.

get.description: Returns authenticated principal profile and roles with Cache-Control: private, no-store.

post.description: Records affirmative user consent for processing purposes.
Revokes access immediately and schedules complete background deletion.

get.description: Retrieves non-content status of an active or completed deletion request.

post.description: Creates a new case owned by the authenticated principal.

get.description: Lists non-deleted cases belonging to the calling principal.
Fetches case details with strict tenant isolation (returns 404 for foreign cases).

patch.description: Updates case fields with optimistic concurrency check (returns 409 on version conflict).

delete.description: Revokes access and queues case for complete asynchronous deletion.

get.description: Retrieves chronological activity log and history for an authorized case.

schema.title: Response Get Case Activity V1 Cases  Id  Activity Get

get.description: P08.2: Lists all active and historical issue tracks for a case.

schema.title: Response List Case Issues V1 Cases  Case Id  Issues Get

post.description: P08.2: Creates a new issue track; rejects brand-only false tracks without statutory basis.
P08.2: Splits an issue track into distinct sub-issues (e.g. non-delivery of Item A vs defect in Item B).

schema.title: Response Split Case Issue V1 Cases  Case Id  Issues Split Post

post.description: P08.2: Merges multiple related issues into one consolidated issue track.

patch.description: P08.2: Reviews or corrects an issue track (accepted, corrected, rejected, unsure).

get.description: P08.2: Evaluates each active issue track independently with distinct remedies and routes.
Retrieves an approved public statutory or procedural provision.
Returns metadata and manifest hash for the active compatible knowledge release.
Reviewer only: inspect discovered and unapproved candidate source versions.

schema.title: Response List Source Candidates V1 Admin Source Candidates Get

post.description: Reviewer only: records explicit named review scope and promotes candidate to approved.
Publisher only: constructs an immutable release manifest; rejects test_only rules (T18).
Publisher only: performs atomic active release pointer swap.
Publisher only: disables active release in an emergency.

get.description: Retrieves all active factual assertions for the authorized case.

schema.title: Response List Case Facts V1 Cases  Case Id  Facts Get

post.description: Creates a normalized factual assertion (money/date/boolean/string) bound to the case.
Submits user review (accept/correct/reject/unsure) for an extracted or asserted fact.
P06.4: Ingests multimodal fact proposal (voice transcript, document OCR/VLM, chat screenshot) into the atomic case facts store.
T08: Extracts structured fact proposals and verbatim text spans from the case story narrative.

parameters.name: auto_persist

schema.description: Whether to automatically persist extracted proposals as draft assertions
schema.title: Auto Persist

parameters.description: Whether to automatically persist extracted proposals as draft assertions

get.description: T19/T20/T30/T32: Computes deterministic procedural assessment, condition traces, NBQ, and next actions.

post.description: Recomputes procedural assessment against the latest active facts.
T31: Ephemeral What-If simulation with ZERO database side effects.
Explicit workflow to commit simulated facts into the actual case as reviewed assertions.

schema.title: Response Apply What If Overrides V1 Cases  Case Id  What If Apply Post

post.description: T32: Answers the Next Best Question, creating an active fact assertion and returning updated assessment.

T32 Invariant: Skipping a question preserves UNKNOWN status (never coerced to false)

and ensures the question is not repetitively prompted.

get.description: P09.1: Returns remedy and stage-aware action DAG with dependency and blocking explanations.
P09.2: Generates editable document AST with sentence source mapping and fact/allegation tags.

post.description: P09.2 & T29: Applies user edit to document AST; marks statement as user_allegation.

get.description: P09.3 & T33: Returns versioned official portal field map with per-field copy data.

post.description: P09.4 & T27: Exports dispute document as Markdown or HTML. Never marks case as filed.
P09.5 & T35: True raster redaction permanently blacking out sensitive pixels in memory.

get.description: P09.7 & T54: Lists official complaint destinations with link health and verified fallbacks.

schema.title: Response List Complaint Destinations V1 Actions Destinations Get

get.description: P09.7 & T54: Returns details for an official complaint destination.
T26: Generates a respectful, legally grounded, unsubmitted dispute request draft.

post.description: T10/T11: Checks case ownership and quota, reserves quota, and generates one-path signed upload intent.

put.description: Direct-to-quarantine payload destination using the one-path upload token.

post.description: T10, T11, T12: Consumes intent once, validates server actual bytes, probes limits/malware, and moves to accepted storage.

get.description: Lists evidence items for the authorized case owner.

schema.title: Response List Case Evidence V1 Cases  Case Id  Evidence Get

get.description: T21: Reconciles asserted transaction amount with linked evidence receipts, prompts for clarifications.
T01: Returns evidence item metadata for authorized case owner.

delete.description: T36: Cascading removal and invalidation of evidence, private files, linked spans and derived assertions.

get.description: T15: Bounded private preview with owner authorization and cache exclusion. Never returns public bucket URL.

post.description: T14, T15: Links evidence region or page to an asserted case fact.

get.description: T14, T15: Lists linked spans for an evidence item.

schema.title: Response List Evidence Spans V1 Cases  Case Id  Evidence  Evidence Id  Spans Get

get.description: T13, T14: Returns parsed document regions with normalized bounding boxes and quality flags.

post.description: T11: Sweeps expired upload tokens, releases quota reservations, and cleans up quarantine.
T22: Ingests voice note, validates container & codec, enforces consent, and transcribes speech to text with uncertainty tags.

get.description: T15, T22: Private playback stream for case owner with strict cache exclusion.

delete.description: T22, T36: Purges private audio recording from storage and marks item deleted.

post.description: T23: Inspects chat/receipt screenshot layout, detects theme, preserves bubble uncertainty, and flags OCR disagreements.
T25: Executes parallel dense E5 and BM25 search with allowed-ID filtering and RRF.
T28: Validates statutory citations against existence, scope, and temporal interval.

get.description:
T24: Exact Bengali/Latin section lookup.

Preserves parent context, subsection exceptions, and qualifications.
Returns match_found=False without inventing missing provisions.

disclaimer_notice.title: Disclaimer Notice
disclaimer_notice.default: PREPARATION MATERIAL ONLY — NOT SUBMITTED BY CLAIMCRAFT BD. Generating or downloading this document does not constitute official submission (T27).

expected_version.title: Expected Version
expected_version.description: Mandatory expected row_version for optimistic concurrency

unsubmitted_banner_notice_en.title: Unsubmitted Banner Notice En
unsubmitted_banner_notice_en.default: UNSUBMITTED DRAFT — Prepared for your personal review. ClaimCraft BD does NOT send or file communications on your behalf. Copying or viewing this draft does not change external filing status.

unsubmitted_banner_notice_bn.title: Unsubmitted Banner Notice Bn
unsubmitted_banner_notice_bn.default: অননুমোদিত খসড়া — শুধুমাত্র আপনার ব্যক্তিগত পর্যালোচনার জন্য প্রস্তুত। ক্লেমক্র্যাফট বিডি কোনো স্বয়ংক্রিয় মেসেজ বা মামলা পাঠায় না। এই খসড়া দেখা বা কপি করা মানেই এটি আনুষ্ঠানিকভাবে প্রেরিত বা দায়েরকৃত নয়।

unsubmitted_disclaimer_en.title: Unsubmitted Disclaimer En
unsubmitted_disclaimer_en.default: PREPARATION MATERIAL ONLY — NOT SUBMITTED BY CLAIMCRAFT BD. Review carefully and file personally via official portal or merchant contact.

unsubmitted_disclaimer_bn.title: Unsubmitted Disclaimer Bn
unsubmitted_disclaimer_bn.default: শুধুমাত্র প্রস্তুতির খসড়া — ক্লেইমক্রাফট বিডি কর্তৃক দাখিলকৃত নয়। ব্যক্তিগতভাবে পর্যালোচনা করে স্বয়ং অফিশিয়াল পোর্টাল বা বিক্রেতার নিকট দাখিল করুন।

expected_version.title: Expected Version
expected_version.description: Mandatory expected row_version for optimistic concurrency (T41)

disclaimer_en.title: Disclaimer En
disclaimer_en.default: Copy values per field into the verified official government portal. ClaimCraft BD never asks for, enters, or stores portal credentials (T33).

disclaimer_bn.title: Disclaimer Bn
disclaimer_bn.default: সরকারি অফিশিয়াল পোর্টালে ফিল্ড অনুযায়ী তথ্য কপি করে বসান। ক্লেইমক্রাফট বিডি কখনোই আপনার পোর্টাল পাসওয়ার্ড চায় না বা স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে প্রবেশ করে না (T33)।

context_note_en.title: Context Note En
context_note_en.default: Official statutory reference verified against enacted gazette.

context_note_bn.title: Context Note Bn
context_note_bn.default: গেজেটভুক্ত অফিসিয়াল সংবিধিবদ্ধ বিধানের সাথে যাচাইকৃত।

disclaimer_notice.title: Disclaimer Notice
disclaimer_notice.default: Personal reminder for tracking convenience only. Does not alter or guarantee statutory limitation periods under CRPA 2009 Section 60 (T40).

disclaimer_en.title: Disclaimer En
disclaimer_en.default: Visually inspected layout proposal. Does not constitute regulatory, banking, or forensic certification of document authenticity.

disclaimer_bn.title: Disclaimer Bn
disclaimer_bn.default: দৃশ্যমান লেআউট প্রস্তাবনা। এটি নথির আনুষ্ঠানিক, ব্যাংকিং বা ফরেনসিক সত্যতা প্রমাণ করে না।
